title: Pure Spright
summary: Pure Spright with generic Rank 2s, Link-2s, and staples. Every main-deck Spright is a Level 2 Thunder monster that Special Summons itself from the hand while you control a Level 2 or Rank 2 monster, with Spright Red and Spright Carrot also counting Link-2 monsters.

summary.title: Starters
points: Spright Blue Special Summons itself next to any Level 2 or Rank 2 monster and adds another Spright monster from your Deck to your hand.
Spright Jet Special Summons itself the same way and adds any Spright Spell or Trap from your Deck to your hand.
Spright Starter Special Summons any Spright monster from your Deck at the cost of LP equal to its original ATK, locking you into Level, Rank, or Link 2 monsters for the rest of the turn.

summary.title: Opening: Spright Starter or Spright Blue
steps: Summon a Level 2 monster or activate Spright Starter to summon Spright Blue from the Deck, searching Spright Jet.
Special Summon Spright Jet to search Spright Double Cross (or Spright Starter if not yet used), then overlay two Level 2s into Gigantic Spright.
Detach 1 material from Gigantic Spright to Special Summon another Level 2 from the Deck, and set up Spright Sprind or I:P Masquerena alongside Spright Red and Spright Carrot.

summary.title: Control & Rank/Link-2 Payoff
points: Gigantic Spright doubles its original ATK when made with a Link/Xyz material and locks both players into Level, Rank, or Link 2 Special Summons for the rest of the turn after detaching to summon from the Deck.

Spright Red and Spright Carrot tribute another Level, Rank, or Link 2 monster to negate a monster effect or Spell/Trap effect respectively, and also destroy that card if you tributed a Rank 2 or Link-2 monster.

Spright Sprind sends a Level 2 monster from the Deck to the GY on Link Summon, and detaches 1 material from an Xyz you control when another monster is Special Summoned to bounce a monster on the field.
Number 65: Djinn Buster negates a monster effect, Onibimaru Soul Sweeper temporarily banishes an opposing monster, and I:P Masquerena Link Summons on the opponent's turn.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Spright Smashers banishes a Springans, Therion, or Spright card from your hand or GY to either summon a Spright, revive a Level/Rank/Link 2, or banish one of your Level/Rank/Link 2s alongside an opposing card without targeting.
Spright Double Cross attaches a monster on the field or GY to your Rank 2 Xyz, steals a monster linked to your Link-2, or revives a Level/Rank/Link 2.
Spright Gamma Burst gives all Level, Rank, and Link 2 monsters on the field +1400 ATK/DEF for the turn to close out games.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Spright Elf is Forbidden in the TCG. Secondary Level 2 packages such as Frog, Nimble, Live Twin, and Runick are left out of this pure build.
